correctness.rationale: Reconstructed joint probability P(N_1=1,N_2=4)=n!b^{n−5}/(4!(n−5)!m^5) and marginal binomial means, giving exact Q. Consecutive quotient Q(n+1)/Q(n)=m(m−2)n(n−3)/[(m−1)^2(n+1)(n−4)], increases up to integer 2m, decreases thereafter, with peak Q(2m)>1 using strict log inequalities. Direct Taylor expansion near n=2m+z√m gives log Q=(1−z²/2)/m²+O(m^{−5/2}) and E1E4/m²→(4/3)e^{−4}; fixed-load covariance/m→−c^4(c−2)^2e^{−2c}/24. Endpoint scaling follows monotonicity. n=4 Y1Y4=0 so negative covariance. Independent exact small m,n rational calculations matched positive intervals; finite checks do not replace proof.
